# Paths fed to BOTH check-stubs implementations' --classify/-Classify mode. The
# two must agree on every line; tests/framework-checks.sh diffs the answers.
#
# One path per line. Blank lines and lines starting with `#` are ignored. The
# files do not have to exist -- classification is a decision about the PATH.
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The two implementations were compared by diffing their
# marker regexes, which are identical and always were. The disagreement lived in
# the file filter next to them: the .sh matched `*[Tt]est*` against the whole path
# and the .ps1 matched it against the filename only, so anything under a directory
# with `test` inside its name counted on one platform and not the other. Two
# implementations of one ratchet that return different numbers means the number
# means nothing, and the one CI reads is not the one the developer saw.
#
# Add the path that disagreed here BEFORE fixing the disagreement.

# --- ordinary source: counted --------------------------------------------
src/app.ts
src/Api/Program.cs
main.go
lib/util.rb
Makefile
src/latest/run.ts
src/testify-helpers/README.rs
build-tools/gen.py
